name: Bietigheim-Bissingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bietigheim-Bissingen (a white tower with a cross on red).
history: The striped flag was taken over from the town of Bietigheim, where it had been in use since at least 1950.

features.role: Bietigheim-Bissingen arms — white tower on red
